items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Fred Sparks (phonetic spelling), a great big fat guy used to always talk about one of these days a strong wind would blow him over and he'll never get up no more, and he outlived Fred many, many, many years.

ctx.x: real skinny. He always was, he always stayed a skinny fellow.

The funny thing about it, Fred Sparks (phonetic spelling), a great big fat guy used to always talk about one of these days a strong wind would blow him over and he'll never get up no more, and he outlived Fred many, many, many years.
Didn't he quit playing to become the manager?
